summary: Cameco Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K dated October 30, 2026, containing its third-quarter 2026 press release, MD&A, interim IFRS financial statements and CEO/CFO Section 302 certifications. The release reports year-to-date results below the prior year, attributing the decline to a planned longer Key Lake mill maintenance outage, lower Westinghouse equity earnings after last year's Dukovany payment, and inflation. It also declares the annual dividend and reiterates disciplined contracting and capital allocation. This is a routine quarterly earnings filing, not a special situation; no transaction, stakeholder action or structural event is disclosed.
